# routing/

Routing-advice cases (`routing.jsonl`, feature 10): one case per scenario and traffic class. A scenario is a set of
deployments of models on the box's disk (public Hugging Face repositories: Qwen/Qwen3-8B, Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B,
google/gemma-4-31B-it, nvidia/Gemma-4-31B-IT-NVFP4, zai-org/GLM-4-32B-0414, ibm-granite/granite-4.2-30b,
Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4, unsloth/Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF; weight sizes and native context from their
snapshots) with plausible configurations, benchmark figures and usage. Deployment and model names are placeholders.

`label` is this project's judged best answer (option keys `dep<id>`; several when equally good): the strongest
capable model for chat / code / tool use (the NVFP4 variant of a model counts as good as its bf16 original and is
faster on GB10), the longest context for long context, the highest concurrency and throughput for batch, preferring
deployments that can serve now unless a stopped one is used regularly. Generated by a throwaway script from the
scenario table; no data from the box beyond the model facts.
